item.title: Technical Writer
item.description:
• Created and maintained developer-facing documentation for B2B software products, collaborating with developers and subject-matter experts to gather, clarify, and validate technical information
• Documented APIs, product functionality, glossaries, workflows, tutorials, how-to guides, and troubleshooting procedures, translating complex technical concepts into clear, structured, task-oriented documentation
• Created flow diagrams and structured documentation to explain complex processes and workflows, while maintaining documentation architecture, information structure, terminology, and consistency across product areas
• Worked in Git-based documentation workflows, reviewing documentation with developers and subject-matter experts to ensure technical accuracy, clarity, and consistency
• Created and maintained documentation using GitBook and Antora (Markdown-based and Asciidoctor-based content), and API documentation using JSDoc, TypeDoc, Swagger, and RapiDoc
• Tested product functionality via API calls and reproduced basic implementation code (e.g., React widgets) to verify accuracy and completeness of technical documentation
• Maintained internal team documentation in Confluence, keeping process and product knowledge organized and up to date
